_note: Official admission prices. One record per attraction; figures read off the operator's own site on the date in `checked`, link in `sourceUrl`. Null = not published / not readable — never guessed. Monthly: re-read each sourceUrl on the 1st; if a figure moved, push the old {checked, adult, child} onto `history` first. `revised` = a fee revision the operator itself announces. Read by lib/attraction-prices-core.js (page, guides, home page and public/data/japan-attraction-prices.csv).
updatePolicy: Every row is re-read on the operator's official site on the 1st of each month, and whenever an operator announces a fee change.
